name: disk_io
description: Diagnostic workflow for disk read/write I/O load, I/O consumption, and disk space usage.

steps.goal: Inspect disk I/O read/write rates, await time, and disk capacity utilization.
Differentiate between static space exhaustion and active I/O throughput bottlenecks.
Check system logs for disk I/O timeout, read-only filesystem, or disk full errors.
Trace API call latency waiting on disk-intensive components such as database nodes.

rules: Disk space exhaustion shows monotonic capacity growth prior to incident onset.
Disk I/O saturation typically causes upstream service request timeouts.
Corroborate high I/O metrics with storage logs before concluding root cause.
